old_assertion: torch.topk first listed ID must equal greedy argmax.
corrected_assertion: Greedy argmax must equal the smallest token ID among stored exactly maximal logits. The stored top10 must still have ten distinct IDs,finite descending logits and valid probability.
scope: One exact tie-order disagreement in saved metadata. No behavior,text,grade,group,dose,model source,cache equality,identity/restoration guard,primary clause or threshold changes. No tolerance.

official_sources.scope: API note: tied indices have no stable-order guarantee.
API note: first maximal position is chosen.

other_source_differences: Only two versioned plan/freeze paths. An exact inverse substitution reconstructs the original auditor source.
top10_limit: This verifies maximality within the saved top10; it does not reconstruct every logit. The frozen worker computes global greedy argmax and saves exact full-logit hashes.
